newsitem.title: USA: Executive TeleCard adopts rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Executive TeleCard adopts rights plan.

text.p: Executive TeleCard Ltd said Tuesday its board of directors had unanimously adopted a shareholders rights plan as well as declared a dividend allowing shareholders to buy preferred stock.

The company said the plan was designed to protect stockholders from abusive takeover tactics, including attempts to acquire control of Executive TeleCard at an inadequate price that would deny stockholders the full value of their investments.

It said the dividend granted shareholders the right to purchase for each common share one 100th of a share of a series of preferred stock that will be set by the company at a price of $70 for each one 100th of a preference share.
The rights will be issued on February 28 to shareholders on that date, it said.
Executive TeleCard is a telecommunications service company providing direct voice and data communications services.
